method.coordinate_system: canvas top-left origin, x right, y down, pixels
method.distance: Euclidean shortest distance from anchor center to the closed label box
method.box_gap: shortest Euclidean distance between two closed label boxes; 0 when overlapping
method.line_inside_box: Liang-Barsky parameter overlap against the closed box; any positive-length overlap fails; only the terminal touch on the own box boundary is allowed
method.line_disk: minimum point-to-segment distance over all segments vs actual point radius 6px
method.crossings: unique (line pair, intersection point) with 1e-6px dedupe; endpoint touches count; adjacent segments of one polyline do not count
method.source: computed from label-layout geometry, not from the rendered pixels
